svg.title: Riven, by Orthrus Research
svg.desc: Riven: five strata at the true depths of a Riven world, 2,048 blocks from Y383 to Y-1664: the sky's limit, the sea, and the floors of the crust, the Beneath and the Infernal Deep, which are 576 blocks each. A fault at the mark's 50 degrees rives them; faint lines show where they lay.
